an4.122:3.3: ‘I’m swamped by rebirth, old age, and death; by sorrow, lamentation, pain, sadness, and distress. I’m swamped by suffering, mired in suffering.
an4.122:3.4: Hopefully I can make an end to this entire mass of suffering.’
an4.122:3.9: we consumed what we wanted, not what we didn’t want;
an4.122:3.10: we tasted what we wanted, not what we didn’t want;
an4.122:3.11: we drank what we wanted, not what we didn’t want.
